2607.28982.title: PARALLEL: A Prefrontal-Aligned Reinforcement inspired Approach for Language-Model Learning under Explicit Limits
2607.28982.paper_summary: Recent language models achieve strong performance across a variety of tasks, but conventional adaptation applies updates uniformly across training samples regardless of their local update benefit. We propose PARALLEL, a prefrontal-aligned reinforcement inspired approach for language-model learning. Inspired by the complementary roles of goal-related and uncertainty-related control, PARALLEL represents these forms of information as separate controller signals and combines them with the current model representation. A reinforcement-inspired controller assigns sample-dependent update intensity using immediate utility-cost feedback. PARALLEL therefore learns when and how strongly to adapt to each sample, prioritizing beneficial updates while limiting unnecessary parameter changes. PARALLEL uses available updates more efficiently than selective baselines while retaining 94.1--99.2\% of Full-adaptation performance. Beyond multiple-choice reasoning, experiments on XSum and CNN/DailyMail show that PARALLEL retains 96.9--98.6\% of the ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-2 scores achieved by Full adaptation and 98.8--98.9\% of the corresponding ROUGE-L scores. When compared at the same cumulative adaptation time or GPU energy, PARALLEL achieves higher ARC accuracy and exhibits a more stable late-stage adaptation trajectory than Full adaptation in the representative run. These results show that learning when and how strongly to update each sample supports stable and efficient post-deployment stream adaptation while avoiding unnecessary updates.
2607.28982.paper_summary_zh: 最近的語言模型在各種任務中表現出色，但傳統的適應方法對訓練樣本均勻地應用更新，而不考慮其局部更新的效益。我們提出了PARALLEL，一種受前額葉啟發的強化學習方法，用於語言模型學習。受到與目標相關的控制和與不確定性相關的控制的互補角色的啟發，PARALLEL將這些信息形式表示為獨立的控制信號，並將其與當前模型表示結合。受強化啟發的控制器根據即時的效用-成本反饋分配樣本依賴的更新強度。因此，PARALLEL學會了何時以及多強烈地適應每個樣本，優先考慮有益的更新，同時限制不必要的參數變更。PARALLEL比選擇性基準更有效地利用可用的更新，同時保留94.1--99.2\%的全適應性能。在多選推理之外，對XSum和CNN/DailyMail的實驗顯示，PARALLEL保留了全適應所達到的ROUGE-1和ROUGE-2分數的96.9--98.6\%，以及相應的ROUGE-L分數的98.8--98.9\%。在相同的累積適應時間或GPU能量下，PARALLEL在代表性運行中實現了更高的ARC準確度，並顯示出比全適應更穩定的晚期適應軌跡。這些結果顯示，學習何時以及多強烈地更新每個樣本支持穩定且高效的部署後流適應，同時避免不必要的更新。
